Akira (1988)_en.title: Akira
Akira (1988)_en.summary: A secret military project endangers Neo-Tokyo when it turns a biker gang member into a rampaging psychic psychopath that only two teenagers and a group of psychics can stop.

Angel Heart (1987).title: Angel Heart
Angel Heart (1987).tagline: It will scare you to your very soul.
Angel Heart (1987).summary: A down-and-out Brooklyn detective is hired to track down a singer on an odyssey that will take him through the desperate streets of Harlem, the smoke-filled jazz clubs of New Orleans, and the swamps of Louisiana and its seedy underworld of voodoo.

Black Samson (1974).title: Black Samson
Black Samson (1974).tagline: Every brother's friend. Every mother's enemy.
Black Samson (1974).summary: Noble nightclub owner Samson does his best to keep his neighborhood clean of crime and drugs. When vicious mobster Johnny Nappa tries to muscle in on Samson's territory, Samson takes a brave stand against Nappa and his flunkies.

Blade (1998).title: Blade
Blade (1998).tagline: Against an army of Immortals, one warrior must draw first blood.
Blade (1998).summary: The Daywalker known as "Blade" - a half-vampire, half-mortal man - becomes the protector of humanity against an underground army of vampires.

Bring Her Back (2025).title: Bring Her Back
Bring Her Back (2025).summary: Following the death of their father, a brother and sister are sent to live with a foster mother, only to learn that she is hiding a terrifying secret.

Bubba Ho-Tep (2002).title: Bubba Ho-Tep
Bubba Ho-Tep (2002).tagline: The King vs. The King of the Dead.
Bubba Ho-Tep (2002).summary: The "true" story of what really became of Elvis Presley. We find Elvis as an elderly resident in an East Texas rest home, who switched identities with an Elvis impersonator years before his "death," then missed his chance to switch back. He must team up with JFK and fight an ancient Egyptian mummy for the souls of their fellow residents.

Dead Ringers (1988).title: Dead Ringers
Dead Ringers (1988).tagline: Two bodies. Two minds. One soul.
Dead Ringers (1988).summary: Elliot, a successful gynecologist, works at the same practice as his identical twin, Beverly. Elliot is attracted to many of his patients and has affairs with them. When he inevitably loses interest, he will give the woman over to Beverly, the meeker of the two, without the woman knowing the difference. Beverly falls hard for one of the patients, Claire, but when she inadvertently deceives him, he slips into a state of madness.

Dead Snow (2009).title: Dead Snow
Dead Snow (2009).summary: Eight medical students on a ski trip to Norway discover that Hitler's horrors live on when they come face to face with a battalion of zombie Nazi soldiers intent on devouring anyone unfortunate enough to wander into the remote mountains where they were once sent to die.

Donnie Darko (2001).title: Donnie Darko
Donnie Darko (2001).tagline: 28 days, 6 hours, 42 minutes, 12 seconds... that is when the world will end.
Donnie Darko (2001).summary: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a large bunny rabbit that manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

Escape From New York (1981).title: Escape From New York
Escape From New York (1981).tagline: 1997. New York City is a walled, maximum security prison. Breaking out is impossible. Breaking in is insane.
Escape From New York (1981).summary: In a world ravaged by crime, the entire island of Manhattan has been converted into a walled prison where brutal prisoners roam free. After the US president crash-lands inside, war hero Snake Plissken has 24 hours to bring him back.

Four Lions (2010).title: Four Lions
Four Lions (2010).summary: Four Lions tells the story of a group of British jihadists who push their abstract dreams of glory to the breaking point. As the wheels fly off, and their competing ideologies clash, what emerges is an emotionally engaging (and entirely plausible) farce.

Heathers (1988).title: Heathers
Heathers (1988).tagline: Best friends, social trends and occasional murder.
Heathers (1988).summary: A girl who halfheartedly tries to be part of the "in crowd" of her school meets a rebel who teaches her a more devious way to play social politics: by killing the popular kids.

Hundreds of Beavers (2024).title: Hundreds of Beavers
Hundreds of Beavers (2024).summary: In the 19th century, a drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America's greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers.

Infinity Pool (2023).title: Infinity Pool
Infinity Pool (2023).tagline: Find out what kind of creature you really are.
Infinity Pool (2023).summary: While staying at an isolated island resort, James and Em are enjoying a perfect vacation of pristine beaches, exceptional staff, and soaking up the sun. But guided by the seductive and mysterious Gabi, they venture outside the resort grounds and find themselves in a culture filled with violence, hedonism, and untold horror. A tragic accident leaves them facing a zero tolerance policy for crime: either you'll be executed, or, if you’re rich enough to afford it, you can watch yourself die instead.

Jacob's Ladder (1990).title: Jacob's Ladder
Jacob's Ladder (1990).tagline: The most frightening thing about Jacob Singer's nightmare is that he isn't dreaming.
Jacob's Ladder (1990).summary: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie, and ex-wife, Sarah, try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis, fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

Jennifer's Body (2009).title: Jennifer's Body
Jennifer's Body (2009).tagline: She's evil... and not just high school evil.
Jennifer's Body (2009).summary: Jennifer, a gorgeous, seductive cheerleader takes evil to a whole new level after she's possessed by a sinister demon. Now it's up to her best friend to stop Jennifer's reign of terror before it's too late.

Ju-On The Grudge (2002)_ja.title: Ju-On The Grudge
Ju-On The Grudge (2002)_ja.tagline: When a grudge from the dead passes to the living, who is safe?
Ju-On The Grudge (2002)_ja.summary: When a social worker is sent to check on a traumatized elderly woman whose family have moved in at the site of a notorious murder case, she unwittingly unleashes a cycle of terror that transmits via its victims.

Labyrinth (1986).title: Labyrinth
Labyrinth (1986).tagline: Where everything seems possible and nothing is what it seems.
Labyrinth (1986).summary: Frustrated with babysitting on yet another weekend night, Sarah, a teenager with an active imagination, summons the Goblins to take her baby stepbrother away. When little Toby actually disappears, Sarah must follow him into a fantastical world to rescue him from the Goblin King. Guarding his castle is the labyrinth itself, a twisted maze of deception, populated with outrageous characters and unknown dangers.

Let's Scare Jessica To Death (1971).title: Let's Scare Jessica To Death
Let's Scare Jessica To Death (1971).tagline: Something is after Jessica. Something very cold, very wet...and very dead.
Let's Scare Jessica To Death (1971).summary: Newly released from a mental ward, Jessica hopes to return to life the way it was before her nervous breakdown. But when Jessica moves to a country house with her husband and a close friend, she finds a mysterious girl living in there. Jessica's terror and paranoia resurface as evil forces surround her.

Lifeforce (1985).title: Lifeforce
Lifeforce (1985).tagline: In the blink of an eye, the terror begins.
Lifeforce (1985).summary: A race of space vampires arrives in London and infects the populace, commencing an apocalyptic descent into chaos.

MaXXXine (2024).title: MaXXXine
MaXXXine (2024).summary: In 1980s Hollywood, adult film star and aspiring actress Maxine Minx finally gets her big break. But as a mysterious killer stalks the starlets of Hollywood, a trail of blood threatens to reveal her sinister past.

My Name Is Bruce (2007).title: My Name Is Bruce
My Name Is Bruce (2007).tagline: Fearless! Unstoppable! Ready For His Close-Up!
My Name Is Bruce (2007).summary: B-movie Legend Bruce Campbell is mistaken for his character Ash from the Evil Dead trilogy and forced to fight a real monster in a small town in Oregon.

One Cut of the Dead (2017).title: One Cut of the Dead
One Cut of the Dead (2017).summary: Real zombies arrive and terrorize the crew of a zombie film being shot in an abandoned warehouse, said to be the site of military experiments on humans.

Parasite (2019).title: Parasite
Parasite (2019).tagline: Act like you own the place.
Parasite (2019).summary: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.

Pearl (2022).title: Pearl
Pearl (2022).summary: Trapped on her family’s isolated farm, Pearl must tend to her ailing father under the bitter and overbearing watch of her devout mother. Lusting for a glamorous life like she’s seen in the movies, Pearl’s ambitions, temptations, and repressions collide.

Pitch Black (2000).title: Pitch Black
Pitch Black (2000).tagline: Don't be afraid of the dark. Be afraid of what's in the dark
Pitch Black (2000).summary: When their ship crash-lands on a remote planet, the marooned passengers soon learn that escaped convict Riddick isn't the only thing they have to fear. Deadly creatures lurk in the shadows, waiting to attack in the dark, and the planet is rapidly plunging into the utter blackness of a total eclipse. With the body count rising, the doomed survivors are forced to turn to Riddick with his eerie eyes to guide them through the darkness to safety. With time running out, there's only one rule: Stay in the light.

Prevenge (2016).title: Prevenge
Prevenge (2016).summary: A pregnant widow, believing herself to be guided by her unborn child, embarks on a homicidal rampage.

Raw (2016)_fr.title: Raw
Raw (2016)_fr.summary: Stringent vegetarian Justine encounters a decadent, merciless, and dangerously seductive world during her first week at veterinary school. Desperate to fit in, she strays from her principles and eats raw meat for the first time. She soon experiences terrible and unexpected consequences as her true self begins to emerge.

Se7en (1995).title: Se7en
Se7en (1995).tagline: Gluttony. Greed. Sloth. Envy. Wrath. Pride. Lust.
Se7en (1995).summary: Two homicide detectives are on a desperate hunt for a serial killer whose crimes are based on the "seven deadly sins" in this dark and haunting film that takes viewers from the tortured remains of one victim to the next. The seasoned Det. Somerset researches each sin in an effort to get inside the killer's mind, while his novice partner, Mills, scoffs at his efforts to unravel the case.

Shaun of the Dead (2004).title: Shaun of the Dead
Shaun of the Dead (2004).summary: Shaun lives a supremely uneventful life, which revolves around his girlfriend, his mother, and, above all, his local pub. This gentle routine is threatened when the dead return to life and make strenuous attempts to snack on ordinary Londoners.

Starship Troopers (1997).title: Starship Troopers
Starship Troopers (1997).tagline: A new kind of enemy. A new kind of war.
Starship Troopers (1997).summary: Set in the future, the story follows a young soldier named Johnny Rico and his exploits in the Mobile Infantry. Rico's military career progresses from recruit to non-commissioned officer and finally to officer against the backdrop of an interstellar war between mankind and an arachnoid species known as "the Bugs."

Team America World Police (2004).title: Team America World Police
Team America World Police (2004).summary: When North Korean ruler Kim Jong-il orchestrates a global terrorist plot, it's up to the heavily armed, highly specialized Team America unit to stop his dastardly scheme. The group, which has recruited troubled Broadway actor Gary Johnston, not only has to face off against Jong-il, but they must also contend with the Film Actors Guild, a cadre of Hollywood liberals at odds with Team America's 'policing the world' tactics.

Teeth (2007).title: Teeth
Teeth (2007).summary: Dawn is an active member of her high-school chastity club but, when she meets Tobey, nature takes its course, and the pair answer the call. They suddenly learn she is a living example of the vagina dentata myth, when the encounter takes a grisly turn.

The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across.title: The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across The 8th Dimension
The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across.tagline: Beings from Another Dimension have invaded your world.
The Adventures Of Buckaroo Banzai Across.summary: Adventurer/surgeon/rock musician Buckaroo Banzai and his band of men, the Hong Kong Cavaliers, take on evil alien invaders from the 8th dimension.

The Blair Witch Project [1999].title: The Blair Witch Project
The Blair Witch Project [1999].summary: In October of 1994 three student filmmakers disappeared in the woods near Burkittsville, Maryland, while shooting a documentary. A year later their footage was found.

The Dark Crystal (1982).title: The Dark Crystal
The Dark Crystal (1982).tagline: Another world, another time... in the age of wonder.
The Dark Crystal (1982).summary: On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal and restore order to his world, before the grotesque race of Skeksis find and use the crystal for evil.

The Disaster Artist (2017).title: The Disaster Artist
The Disaster Artist (2017).tagline: Based on the true story of one movie so bad it became infamous.
The Disaster Artist (2017).summary: An aspiring actor in Hollywood meets an enigmatic stranger by the name of Tommy Wiseau, the meeting leads the actor down a path nobody could have predicted; creating the worst movie ever made.

The Hitcher (1986).title: The Hitcher
The Hitcher (1986).tagline: The terror starts the moment he stops.
The Hitcher (1986).summary: On a stormy night, young Jim, who transports a luxury car from Chicago to California to deliver it to its owner, feeling tired and sleepy, picks up a mysterious hitchhiker, who has appeared out of nowhere, thinking that a good conversation will help him not to fall asleep. He will have enough time to deeply regret such an unmeditated decision.

The Hunger (1983).title: The Hunger
The Hunger (1983).summary: Five-thousand-year-old vampire Miriam promises her lovers the gift of eternal life. When John, her cellist companion for centuries, discovers that he has suddenly begun growing old, he attempts to seek out the help of Dr. Sarah Roberts, a researcher on the mechanisms of aging.

The Lighthouse (2019).title: The Lighthouse
The Lighthouse (2019).tagline: There is enchantment in the light.
The Lighthouse (2019).summary: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

The Menu (2022).title: The Menu
The Menu (2022).summary: A young couple travels to a remote island to eat at an exclusive restaurant where the chef has prepared a lavish menu, with some shocking surprises.

The Pool (2018)_THA.title: The Pool
The Pool (2018)_THA.tagline: No water. No ladder. No way out.
The Pool (2018)_THA.summary: Left alone to clean up a 6-meter-deep deserted pool, Day falls asleep on an inflatable raft. When he wakes, the water level has sunk so low that he can't climb out on his own. Stuck in the pool, Day screams for help, but the only thing that hears him is a creature from a nearby crocodile farm.

The Room (2003).title: The Room
The Room (2003).tagline: Can you ever really trust anyone?
The Room (2003).summary: Johnny is a successful banker with great respect for and dedication to the people in his life, especially his future wife Lisa. The happy-go-lucky guy sees his world being torn apart when his friends begin to betray him one-by-one.

The Vindicator (1986).title: The Vindicator
The Vindicator (1986).tagline: They thought they took his life...now he wants theirs. Invincible. Unstoppable. Indestructible. He's out on the street and out of control!
The Vindicator (1986).summary: An employee of a secret company operation becomes the victim of the company's special weapons project. He is transformed into a robotic killing machine that, because of his programming must destroy anything that comes near him.

The Witch (2015).title: The Witch
The Witch (2015).summary: In 1630, a farmer relocates his family to a remote plot of land on the edge of a forest where strange, unsettling things happen. With suspicion and paranoia mounting, each family member's faith, loyalty and love are tested in shocking ways.

Thoroughbreds (2017).title: Thoroughbreds
Thoroughbreds (2017).summary: Lily and Amanda, two high school students living in suburban Connecticut, rekindle their unlikely friendship after years of drifting apart. Together, they devise a plan to kill Lily's abusive stepfather by hiring a lowlife drug dealer.

X (2022).title: X
X (2022).tagline: Dying to show you a good time.
X (2022).summary: In 1979, a group of young filmmakers set out to make an adult film in rural Texas, but when their reclusive, elderly hosts catch them in the act, the cast find themselves fighting for their lives.
